subject: Brightline MAP: unit-cost certification & evaluation gating
body:
From: Lena Baker <lena.baker@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightlinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff + cost certification ask

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Marcus and I want to get the MAP started so our procurement and engineering teams can close the pilot decision in the next three weeks. Two gating asks from our side before we move to signature:

1) A worked-through cost model (tokens/$) for our expected profile (multi-turn clinical intake flows, avg 420 tokens/request, peak 90 reqs/min, expected 70% cache hit on prefixes).
2) A short evaluation plan that verifies QA/accuracy doesn't regress under quantized model caching/batched inference.

I've attached Brightline's initial traffic extract and put the MAP template you shared in the drive link. Can you assign owners internally and confirm the timeline for the cost certification run?

Appreciate it — Lena
Brightline Health

Attachment: brightline_traffic_sample.csv (csv)

---

On Tue, 12 Sep 2028 at 10:03 Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Lena Baker <lena.baker@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 10:03:21 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff + cost certification ask

Lena — thanks, and glad the demo landed. We're ready to run the cost certification and bake the checks into the MAP. Quick proposal:

- Day 0 (today): confirm traffic slices and assumptions.
- Day 1–2: Redwood to run batch simulations across three execution profiles: 1) streaming low-latency (no batching), 2) small-batch (batch size 8, prefetched KV caching), 3) high-throughput (batch size 32, quantized weights). Each profile will produce tokens/$, p50/p95 latencies, and a quality delta on a 200-example eval set you provide.
- Day 4: Deliver a cost-cert report + tuned MAP items (recommended batching, cache TTLs, fallback routing).

Owners: Karthik (cost sims & batching configs), Hannah (eval plan & quality baselines), Kimberly (MAP doc updates & procurement artifacts). I'll be your single point of contact for coordination and escalations.

Can you confirm the eval examples we should use (redacted PHI OK if de-identified) and whether Brightline requires SOC2 evidence in parallel?

Best,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_map_template.docx (docx)

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff + cost certification ask (internal planning)

Pinging to confirm inputs so we can scope the batch sims this afternoon. Need a few clarifications from Brightline before we run:

- Traffic distribution: % of single-turn vs multi-turn? The sample looked ~60% multi-turn. That materially affects KV cache hit expectations.
- Expected average output length vs input tokens (you're estimating 420 total tokens/request — is that input+output or output only?).
- Any strict latency SLOs during pilot (p95 < 800ms?) — that changes batch sizing tradeoffs.

Planned sims:
- Profile A (Low latency): batch=1, no prefetched KV, quantization off; measure tokens/$, p50/p95.
- Profile B (Balanced): batch up to 8 with dynamic batching, prefix caching enabled (simulate 70% hit), int8 quantization on last-layer kernels; measure quality delta on eval set.
- Profile C (Throughput): batch up to 32, larger KV cache, aggressive quantization (int4 where safe).

Deliverable format: 1) tokens-per-dollar table by profile and load, 2) recommended MAP gating acceptance criteria (max p95 latency, acceptable quality delta), 3) updated MAP timeline with sign-off checkpoints.

I'll spin up sims once Hannah confirms eval harness and Kimberly confirms procurement items.

-karthik
Sr. Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Lena Baker <lena.baker@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 07:43:12 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff + cost certification ask

Lena — thanks for the sample. Marcus, if you can confirm the 200 eval examples and whether we should include a small withheld test set for hallucination/regression checks that would be ideal. We will:

1) Run the candidate-model eval on your 200 examples across the three runtime profiles Karthik outlined. We'll report quality delta (F1 / task-specific metric where applicable) and flag any >2.5% degradation.
2) Instrument a simple regression harness: Jaccard/semantic-similarity fallback check + manual review for any red-flag cases.
3) Deliver the first cost table with tokens-per-dollar normalized to 1M tokens and a traffic-weighted cost for your projected month.

Proposed timeline:
- Sep 14 EOD: Brightline confirms eval examples and target SLOs.
- Sep 15–16: Redwood runs sims and evals.
- Sep 17: We send cost-cert report + MAP update.
- Sep 18: Joint readout + procurement checklist complete.

If that timeline works we'll mark the MAP milestone 'cost-cert' as gated for procurement approval.

Hannah
Product Manager, Evaluations

Attachment: brightline_eval_template.csv (csv)

---

From: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Lena Baker <lena.baker@brightlinehealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 09:02:40 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff + cost certification ask

Jonas/Hannah/Karthik — attaching the 200 eval examples (de-identified) and confirming:

- Traffic split: 58% multi-turn, 42% single-turn.
- The 420 tokens/request estimate is total tokens (input + expected output).
- Latency request: p95 target 900ms during pilot (we can tolerate short spikes during non-business hours).

Also, procurement flagged that they need an explicit line in the MAP that states unit cost assumptions (tokens/$ baseline and key sensitivity scenarios) before legal will countersign. We have procurement on the thread (procurement@brightlinehealth.com).

Attachment: brightline_200_eval_deid.csv (csv)

Cheers,
Marcus
Dir. Product Ops, Brightline Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Baker <lena.baker@brightlinehealth.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@brightlinehealth.com>, procurement@brightlinehealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff + cost certification ask — deliverables and next steps

Lena/Marcus/procurement team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary of deliverables (as of right now):

1) Cost-cert report (Sep 17 delivered): tokens-per-dollar table for A/B/C profiles, traffic-weighted monthly estimate, sensitivity scenarios for cache hit +/-15% and batch-size variation.
2) Eval summary (Sep 17 delivered): quality delta per profile on the 200 example set; we flagged 3 examples for manual review where int4 quant produced subtle truncation.
3) MAP update (attached): updated gating language that procurement can include in the SOW. Key snippet included below.

Key MAP gating language (proposed):
"Redwood will deliver a cost-certification report and MAP appendix that documents baseline tokens-per-dollar and three sensitivity scenarios (cache hit high/low, batch small/large, quantization on/off). Procurement approval is contingent on acceptance of the traffic-weighted cost estimate and the defined quality threshold (no >2.5% task-specific metric degradation)."

Action items:
- Procurement: confirm whether the MAP gating language above is acceptable for the SOW.
- Brightline eng: confirm acceptance of the flagged eval examples and whether you'd like us to run an extended int8/int4 mitigation (we can re-run small set).
- Redwood: Kimberly to attach procurement checklist (PO process, SOC2 cert link); Karthik/Hannah to schedule 30-minute readout on Sep 18.

I'll set a 30-minute slot for Sep 18 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET for the readout and procurement Q&A unless someone objects.

Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: brightline_map_update_v1.docx (docx)
